title: CYBRIK Suite W2-G organizational-hierarchy + external-authority-boundary contract packet — compatibility/version manifest
description: Inventory and compatibility record for the W2-G organizational-hierarchy + external-authority-boundary contract packet. ADDITIVE to, and DISJOINT from, the accepted v0.1 cross-product packet, the ACCEPTED W2-D inference packet, and the ACCEPTED W2-F service-delegation packet: it introduces the cybrik.org-* JSON Schema namespace and REUSES accepted primitives (common-defs, data-marking) by $ref without modifying them. It is the contract realization of the ADR-0007 org-hierarchy model (ACCEPTED at Gate W2-C1) as detailed in ADR-0009 (contract delta D-1..D-8). Every member here is ACCEPTED FOR IMPLEMENTATION at v0.1.0 (not stable v1/GA) as of Gate W2-G (Codex under Founder delegation, 2026-07-24); products MAY now implement contract-first against v0.1.0. This is an implementation-authorization acceptance only — NOT a stable v1/GA promotion and NOT an ADR-0001 immutable bundle tag. $id uses the RFC 2606 .example documentation domain; it is an identifier, not an endpoint.
wire_scope: NO SERVER / NO ENDPOINT. This packet declares no OpenAPI server, AsyncAPI channel, host, route, or operational URL. It is a set of JSON Schema validation contracts (org_node / lifecycle / membership / scope-grant / edge / external-exchange / aggregate request+result) plus a mapping note. There is NO OPERATIONAL SERVER: the SOC migration (illustrative 0022), API, and UI it maps onto are owned and separately gated by cybrik-soc-command-center and are NOT built here.
mcp_scope: OUT OF SCOPE. This packet defines no MCP server/tool/action contract and grants no tool/function/agent authority. Hierarchy is authority routing and de-identified visibility, never tool execution; tool execution remains governed by the accepted Tool-Fabric packet (ADR-0004).

adr_basis.role: versioning/format-pin policy; this packet stays v0.1.0 ACCEPTED FOR IMPLEMENTATION (not stable v1/GA) and is never a bundle tag.
cross-product event & identity model: tenant is the fail-closed isolation boundary; actor identity; objectRef digest-binding; delegation temporal/SoD primitives reused by grantTemporal.

organizational-hierarchy & external-authority-boundary MODEL + open-decision constraints OD-1..OD-6. This packet is the contract realization of that accepted model; it applies the model, it does not re-decide it.

org-hierarchy + external-authority contract profile: the contract delta D-1..D-8 (org_node/tier-as-data, membership, scope_kind + INV-1 raw/aggregate split, typed edges, external exchange, break-glass, aggregate roll-up), invariants INV-1/INV-2 + FC-1..FC-10. This packet is that ADR's contract realization.

adr_out_of_scope.reason: Tool execution authority / capability registry / approval / the digest-bound cybrik.delegation-chain.v1 tool-grant — a SEPARATE accepted packet. This packet grants no tool/action/agent authority; hierarchy is authority routing + de-identified visibility only. An escalated/delegated object references objectRef but confers no tool grant.

Internal service-delegation + workload-identity seam (W2-F). org_scope on that seam is opaque/advisory only; this packet defines the authoritative org model but does not run at, or depend on, that transport seam.
Durable agent orchestration / bus choice — NOT decided here; this packet declares no servers, channels, or bindings.

reuses_accepted_unmodified.note: These accepted v0.1 members are referenced by $ref and are NOT modified, re-versioned, or re-stated by this packet. Backward compatibility of the accepted packet is preserved.

members.title: org scope grant (INV-1 raw/aggregate split + break-glass)
org-hierarchy -> SOC migration/API/UI mapping notes (NO operational server)

contract_delta_traceability.note: The ADR-0007 §Consequences / 05-contract-delta-proposal.md D-1..D-8 sketch, APPLIED as accepted schemas at Gate W2-G. Each delta was PROPOSED (05 §4) and is now ACCEPTED FOR IMPLEMENTATION as the named schema(s). Applying the delta does NOT implement it in any product.

deltas.concept: org_node / tier structure + governed lifecycle (tier is DATA, no fixed tier names; tree not DAG; no hard-delete of referenced nodes)
org_membership: actor -> internal org_node -> role archetype; confers node capability, never descendant raw

deltas.status: APPLIED (ACCEPTED FOR IMPLEMENTATION) — realized as the shared jurisdiction/residencyZone $defs in org-common-defs and referenced by org-node and org-external-exchange; the accepted cybrik.data-marking.v1 is REUSED UNMODIFIED (no minor bump applied to it).

deltas.concept: scope_kind + subject_relationship: the INV-1 raw/aggregate split encoded in the schema
typed org edges: parent / escalation / tasking / case-delegation / exchange (parent+tasking never confer raw read)
external-exchange: distinct external-auth context, explicit direction, inbound never auto-executes
break-glass grant variant: loud, role-gated, read-only default, 15-min default / 60-min max requiring second approval, self-revoking
aggregate roll-up request+result: de-identified, small-cell floor k=5, never carries a raw record/objectRef

invariants.note: The load-bearing invariants realized by this packet. INV-1/INV-2 are the ADR-0007 hard invariants; FC-1..FC-10 are the 04-threat-model fail-closed properties. Some are STRUCTURAL (enforced by the JSON Schemas and exercised by fixtures); others are RUNTIME-ONLY (the relying party MUST enforce; JSON Schema constrains shape only). Both are REQUIRED of every implementation.
hard: INV-1 Hierarchy implies no raw-data access: ancestry grants governance only (task, de-identified aggregate roll-up, policy). Raw descendant records require a SEPARATE explicit grant PLUS object-level need-to-know. Structurally: subject_relationship='ancestor-governance' forbids raw_scope and forces scope_kind='aggregate'; scope_kind='descendant' forces an explicit-descendant-grant with a non-empty raw_scope; parent/tasking edges force confers_raw_read=false.

INV-2 External authority is never super-admin: an 'external' (A05) node is an exchange peer, never a parent/ancestor (org-node external -> parent_id null; org-edge 'parent' from_node const internal), never an org_node member (org-membership node_boundary_kind const internal), never reuses an internal token (org-external-exchange authorization additionalProperties:false, auth_context const 'external-distinct'), and an inbound directive never auto-executes (auto_execute const false).
structural: FC-3 (INV-1) Hierarchy != read: ancestor-governance is aggregate-only (raw_scope:false); parent/tasking edges confers_raw_read const false.
FC-4 Aggregate is de-identified: aggregate grants/requests/results carry no raw_scope and no objectRef; every unsuppressed cell count minimum 5 (small-cell floor const 5).
FC-5 (INV-2) External is exchange-only: external node never a parent/member; inbound directive never auto-executes.
FC-8 Confused-deputy defense on exchange: external authorization.audience binds to the external peer; auth_context const 'external-distinct'.
D-1 no-hard-delete: org-node status enum has no 'deleted'; org-node-lifecycle operation enum is suspend|reactivate|archive|restore (a 'delete' is not expressible).
runtime_only: FC-1 Default deny: absent an explicit, unexpired, in-scope grant, every read/action is denied; an aggregate request without a matching, unexpired aggregate grant is denied. AND-composed with tenant RLS + RBAC. An empty raw_scope denies (never grant-all).

FC-2 Tenant first (OD-1): authoritative tenant derives from the caller credential; org_node never weakens tenant isolation. The relying party MUST reject a cross-tenant hierarchy edge (from_node.tenant_binding != to_node.tenant_binding) and a cross-tenant grant. Backfill stays same-tenant + internal.
ACYCLICITY: the relying party MUST reject an edge whose endpoints form a cycle (including from_node == to_node); tree, not DAG (a schema cannot walk the graph).
TREE-RELATIONSHIP: the relying party MUST verify the subject's tree relationship to target_node matches subject_relationship (a sibling/unrelated node is not a valid descendant target).
FC-6 Marking/residency gate (AC-9): marking is re-checked on every crossing and is NEVER downgraded relative to origin_marking; residency is deny-by-default (a zone not in allowed_zones is denied).
FC-7 Grants expire and revoke immediately: an expired (expires_at < now) or revoked grant re-authorizes nothing on idempotent replay; break-glass self-revokes at max_duration_seconds.
FC-9 Availability never widens authority: external unreachability queues the exchange; it never elevates authority.
FC-10 Fail-closed on ambiguity: unknown tier config, missing jurisdiction, or an unresolved relationship denies.
D-8 dimension subset: aggregate-request.dimensions MUST be a subset of the authorizing grant's aggregate_scope.dimensions; tenant/target/floor MUST match the grant.
SoD: under separation_of_duties the grantor/approver MUST be distinct from the subject (self-authorization rejected).

backward_compatibility.namespace: Disjoint: schema ids cybrik.org-*. No accepted id, event type, or channel is redefined; the W2-D inference (cybrik.model-*/cybrik.alert-summarization-*) and W2-F service-delegation (cybrik.svc-*) namespaces are unchanged and untouched.
backward_compatibility.relation_to_w2f_service_delegation: The W2-F seam treats org_scope as opaque/advisory (ADR-0008 D4). This packet defines the AUTHORITATIVE org model. The two are additive and disjoint: this packet imports, modifies, and re-states no W2-F schema, and grants no delegation-token / transport authority.
backward_compatibility.feature_flag_default_off: The implementing (SOC) surface ships behind a feature flag that defaults OFF; with it off the product behaves as the accepted v0.1 single-tier surface (backward compatible). See the mapping notes 'Feature flag & rollback'.

compatibility_and_backfill.note: Reorg-churn (AC-11) and rollback handling, contract-first. These are obligations on the implementation, not proven by a green validator.
compatibility_and_backfill.sunset: This is v0.1.0 ACCEPTED FOR IMPLEMENTATION, not GA. There is no N-1 back-compat obligation pre-GA (ADR-0001 D2). Any future incompatible change MUST be recorded here with its SemVer treatment; a superseded org schema is DEPRECATED with a recorded sunset, never silently removed.
compatibility_and_backfill.backfill: On reorg churn a node is ARCHIVED (never hard-deleted, D-1); its live memberships/edges MAY be reassigned to a SAME-TENANT INTERNAL successor via org-node-lifecycle.backfill (never cross-tenant / external). Stable opaque org_node_id + editable label metadata absorb tier renames without breaking references (AC-11).
compatibility_and_backfill.rollback: Rollback = clear the feature flag (surface reverts to flat v0.1) and reverse the additive migration; audit history is never hard-deleted.

gate.status: DECIDED — ACCEPTED FOR IMPLEMENTATION (v0.1.0; not stable v1/GA)
gate.decided_by: Codex, under explicit Founder delegation of Gate W2-G (not agent-inferred)
decisions_resolved: G-W2G-1 ACCEPTED: the ADR-0007 org-hierarchy model contract delta D-1..D-8 is APPLIED as the accepted cybrik.org-* JSON Schema packet (v0.1.0), additive to and disjoint from the accepted v0.1 / W2-D / W2-F packets.

G-W2G-2 ACCEPTED: INV-1 (hierarchy != raw read) is encoded structurally in org-scope-grant and org-edge; raw descendant access requires an explicit-descendant-grant with a non-empty raw_scope + need-to-know; ancestor reach is aggregate-only.

G-W2G-3 ACCEPTED: INV-2 (external authority never super-admin) is encoded structurally across org-node/org-edge/org-membership/org-external-exchange; an external peer is never an ancestor/member/internal-token, and an inbound directive never auto-executes.

G-W2G-4 ACCEPTED: tiers are DATA (ordinal + locale label keys; no fixed tier names), aggregates apply a k=5 small-cell floor and never carry raw records, external crossings are marked/residency-gated (deny-by-default) and never downgrade marking, and referenced nodes are archived (no hard-delete).

G-W2G-5 ACCEPTED: the packet declares NO operational server/endpoint and grants NO tool/agent/MCP authority; the SOC migration (illustrative 0022) / API / UI it maps onto are owned + separately gated by cybrik-soc-command-center and are NOT IMPLEMENTED here; the surface ships feature-flag-OFF with a documented rollback/backfill.
gate.evidence_ref: See acceptance.evidence[] and cybrik-suite:docs/releases/GATE-W2-G-ORG-HIERARCHY-ACCEPTANCE-2026-07-24.md. A green validator/secret-scan run is a conformance signal; acceptance is the recorded Founder-delegated decision, not an inference from CI.

acceptance.decided_by: Codex, under explicit Founder delegation of Gate W2-G (not agent-inferred)
acceptance.scope: Products MAY now implement against the W2-G org-hierarchy packet v0.1.0. This is an implementation-authorization acceptance only; it is NOT a stable v1/GA promotion and NOT an ADR-0001 immutable bundle tag. The packet version remains 0.1.0 and x-cybrik-is-bundle-tag remains false. The runtime-only invariants (invariants.runtime_only: FC-1/FC-2/FC-6/FC-7/FC-9/FC-10 + acyclicity/tree-relationship/dimension-subset/SoD) remain explicit and REQUIRED of every implementation; a green validator run proves standards conformance and fixture coverage, not runtime enforcement, and not the existence of any migration/API/UI. NOTHING IS IMPLEMENTED, VERIFIED, PILOTED, OR GA.
evidence: Pinned standards validation green: JSON Schema 2020-12 compile/ref-resolution of the 9 org schemas (reusing common-defs + data-marking unmodified), 21/21 positive + 10/10 negative-schema + 6/6 negative-semantic fixtures, per-member SHA256 integrity verified against this manifest, and the INV-1/INV-2 + FC-* invariant assertions each exercised by a fixture; git diff --check clean; gitleaks secret scan clean (no credential/key material is a wire field anywhere in the packet).

Independent post-validator security/compatibility review: packet internally coherent at v0.1.0, additive to and disjoint from the accepted v0.1 / W2-D / W2-F packets, no tool/agent authority, external (A05) boundary kept distinct (never ancestor/member/internal-token/auto-execute), no operational endpoint / migration / server introduced, feature-flag-OFF with documented rollback/backfill.
acceptance.mechanics: Acceptance-for-implementation was authorized by explicit Founder delegation of Gate W2-G to Codex and recorded with evidence in this commit (ADR-0001 D5). No approval was inferred from CI going green. Promotion to a stable v1/GA version or an immutable bundle tag remains a separate Founder gate (ADR-0001 D6).
